# Plug Power Reports Continued Business Progress, Sets Dates for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Call and Global Plug Symposium


October 15, 2026


Plug is providing an update today on its 2026 business progress, highlighting improvements across three key business priorities: sales growth, margin enhancement, and improved cash flows. The Company is also sharing details for its upcoming third quarter earnings call scheduled for November 9 and Plug Symposium 2026 scheduled for November 19.
